{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Identify rows where baseline is -999.0
sentinel_rows = df[df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999.0]

# Check if any of these rows have a valid final value
valid_final = sentinel_rows[sentinel_rows['biomarker_final'] != -999.0]

# Check if any have final = -999.0
invalid_final = sentinel_rows[sentinel_rows['biomarker_final'] == -999.0]

print(f"Total rows with baseline = -999.0: {len(sentinel_rows)}")
print(f"Rows with baseline = -999.0 but final ≠ -999.0: {len(valid_final)}")
print(f"Rows with both baseline and final = -999.0: {len(invalid_final)}")"}
